content.Title: 2022 ACC/AHA Aortic Disease Guideline
content.Focus: Management and surgical approaches for aortic aneurysms, specifically those affecting the aortic root and ascending aorta, with special considerations for conditions like Marfan syndrome and bicuspid aortic valve.
Topics: Decision-making in clinical application for ascending aortic aneurysm.
Natural history and management of aortic aneurysms.
Guidelines for surgical approach in the context of Marfan syndrome and bicuspid aortic valve.
Prognostic factors and risk assessment for timing of surgical intervention.
Outcomes of different surgical techniques, including valve-sparing procedures.
Key Sections: 6.5.1.1: Surgical Approach for Patients With Saccular Aneurysms of the Aortic Root and Ascending Aorta Meeting Criteria for Surgery

genes.context: ACTA2 mutations are associated with thoracic aortic aneurysms and dissections, highlighting the genetic component in deciding surgical intervention.
